name: Marris
source:
"Welcome to Remoire, Starlight."

Marris, a charismatic, free-spirited being who resembles more of a nomadic wanderer than the god of an entire world. He saves you from death’s cold clutches and whisks you away to the safety of his realm. Your survival is dependent on this flippant god’s power.

While you are not, technically, fated to Marris, your souls are tied together by the strings of fate themselves. Amidst your quest for revenge, you find yourself faced with more questions than answers. Why did this god save you, and what secrets are hiding behind his sunshine-like radiance?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eternallovestudios/shattered-souls-a-dark-fantasy-isekai-otome]Kickstarter[/url]]
